summary: Disclosure of the 2026-11-13 audit findings on issue execution (F1-F4) and verdict binding (C1) in a public repository

options.description: File F1 and C1 openly now; file F2-F4 only after the F1 author gate has landed
Track all in a private GitHub security advisory and publish with the fix
File nothing; keep only the interim rule

body: Problem: three findings were unfiled because a backlog task in this public repository is a disclosure. F1: outsider issue text reaches a developer agent with no author check. F2-F4: the untrusted-run hook does not contain that agent. C1: a verdict record is bound to a commit, not to its PR. Trade-off: exposure time against fix speed; a GitHub advisory private fork runs no Actions, so a private fix gets no CI and cannot use the drain.
